$comment: Per-series harvest lists for the Harvest tab. Checkbox state lives in the per-dinner Firestore doc (state.harvest). Built 2026-08-24 off Tim/Kelly's 8/24 replies + the September series-data sourcing table. GENERATED UNDER THE GARDEN-PICK GUIDELINE (print-pack-standard.md, added 2026-08-24): the garnish-class sweep ran against series-data build/guest_copy fields — basil blossoms, mint, tender herbs, fig leaves caught; no edible-flower plate this menu (checked, not omitted). Farm morning-picks: tomatoes, figs, padron/shishito + sweet peppers, cucumbers, mint, basil, herbs. Salmon, clams, chanterelles, clam stock, crumble, saba and fennel pollen come UP with the load. Fig leaves and King apples go DOWN to SF on Sully's Tuesday run. ⚠ SELL-NAME VALIDATION REQUIRED before publish: 'Figs (Farm)', 'Apples (King)', 'Guanciale' and 'Beef NY/Rib Eye steaks' are NEW names not yet verified against Kelly's Remy sheet — figs/apples/steaks are flagged unpriced:true (Tim prices at finalize); ask Kelly to add Figs and Apples to her Remy sheet — they're real farm income. Fig leaves ARE on her sheet (Peak, 20 lb). Run validate_harvest.py after any edit. sell:{skip:...} lines never reach the invoice. UPDATED 2026-08-30: romesco recipe locked (Chris) — sweet-peppers-romesco removed from farm-morning picks and re-added as DOWN-TO-SF confirm rows per Sam's quantities: peppers 10 lb, zucchini 5 lb, parsley 1/2 lb. ALL CORN IS CHRIS-SOURCED (Sam, 8/30) — no farm corn rows; grilled corn for the pasta comes UP with the load. 'Zucchini (Farm)' IS on Kelly's live sheet (Trickling, 8/19); 'Parsley (Farm)' is NOT — flagged unpriced.
